items.title: NRG Energy Reports Soon: How Has The Stock Reacted To Past Earnings?
items.summary: NRG Energy (NYSE:NRG) is scheduled to report its earnings on Monday, November 9, 2026. The company has a market value of about $17.0 billion. Over the last twelve months it generated $33.1 billion in revenue and $2.1 billion in operating profit, with net income of $849 million.

items.title: Constellation Energy Earnings Ahead: What Past Reactions Say About The Stock
items.summary: Constellation Energy (NASDAQ:CEG) is scheduled to report its earnings on Monday, November 9, 2026. The company has a market value of about $86.3 billion. Over the last twelve months it generated $31.3 billion in revenue and $4.5 billion in operating profit, with net income of $3.5 billion.
